# I01.4-A — Dependency lock handoff

Date: 2026-10-09
Branch: `task/I01-dependency-lock`
Base revision: `b1b96b9ef3d0405daae370f769c216f551c0d8a1`

## Delivered

Created and validated:

* `pyproject.toml` requiring Python `>=3.12,<3.13`, with runtime and
  development groups, optional `ollama` client extra, and minimal reproducible
  Ruff/strict-async configuration.
* `uv.lock`, generated by uv with 71 resolved packages.
* `frontend/package.json` with React runtime dependencies, Vite/TypeScript
  development dependencies, scripts and Node/npm engine ranges.
* `frontend/package-lock.json`, lockfileVersion 3.
* The I01.4 run report at `docs/runs/I01.4-dependency-lock.md`.

Resolved direct versions include `mcp 2.3.0`, `langgraph 1.2.14`,
`langgraph-checkpoint 4.2.0`, `langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite 3.1.1`,
`fastapi 0.143.0`, `pydantic 2.14.0`, `react 19.3.0`, `vite 7.3.7` and
`typescript 5.9.3`. The official MCP v2 generation is used exclusively; no
adapter package or v1 SDK was added.

## Verification and boundaries

`uv lock --check`, `uv tree --locked --depth 1`,
`npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts`, and
`npm ci --dry-run --ignore-scripts` passed. The dry-run did not create
`frontend/node_modules`; `.venv`, `node_modules`, `.env` and local-secret paths
remain ignored. No project package was installed, no service was started, and
no Ollama model or daemon was downloaded.

The report records the initial pre-lock npm dry-run failure (missing lockfile),
the successful retry, exact selected versions, registry/cache limitation and
unresolved licence/security/runtime metadata. A lock is not proof of imports,
model performance, release readiness or any project gate.

## Next task

Proceed only to the next explicitly scoped environment/bootstrap or bounded
